scripts.validate: for skill in skills/*/; do uvx --python 3.13 --from skills-ref agentskills validate "$skill" || exit 1; done
scripts.check:tier1: for skill in skills/*/; do skillevaluator tier1 "$skill" --no-llm --skillspector-baseline .skillevaluator/baselines/eval-fixtures.yaml -o "reports/tier1/$(basename "$skill")" || exit 1; done
scripts.check:harness: for skill in skills/*/; do skillevaluator harness-check "$skill"; done
scripts.eval:validate: for skill in skills/*/; do skillevaluator tier3 validate "$skill" --strict || exit 1; done
